question_cn: B 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group B?
one_liner_cn: 瑞士与东道主加拿大几乎五五开，但加拿大开赛前伤病扎堆（戴维斯、邦比托、大卫），天平略向阵容完整的瑞士倾斜。
one_liner_en: Switzerland and host Canada are near a coin flip, but Canada's pre-tournament injury cluster (Davies, Bombito, David) tilts the scale slightly toward a fully intact Switzerland.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 上瑞士（1891，第17）领先加拿大（1788，第25），加上东道主小组赛 +100 Elo 加成后，10 万次模拟中两队头名概率 50.0% vs 48.0%，本质是双雄之争。
key_reasons.en: On Elo, Switzerland (1891, No. 17) lead Canada (1788, No. 25); with the +100 host bonus in group games, the 100k-sim baseline is 50.0% vs 48.0% — effectively a two-horse race.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大开赛前减员严重：队长戴维斯腿筋伤、首战存疑，主力中卫邦比托据报道因伤被移出名单，头号射手大卫整季仅 6 个意甲进球、状态低迷。
key_reasons.en: Canada enter depleted: captain Davies (hamstring) is doubtful for the opener, centre-back Bombito has reportedly been removed from the roster through injury, and top striker David scored just 6 Serie A goals all season.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士核心阵容完整：亚卡任队长、阿坎吉刚随国米夺意甲冠军、科贝尔镇守球门，无关键缺阵，与加拿大的伤情形成不对称。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland's core is intact: Xhaka captains, Akanji arrives fresh off a Serie A title, Kobel in goal, no key absences — an asymmetry against Canada's injury situation.

method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (100,000 full-tournament sims, seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 Elo host bonus in group games only, no market input), then a bounded evidence-based adjustment of at most ±4pp per team (Canada −4pp injury cluster, Switzerland +3pp intact squad, Bosnia +1pp opener vs depleted Canada, Qatar 0), renormalized to sum 1.
